import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/codex-review-phase1b-duration')
JOB = pathlib.Path.home() / '.codex-review/0f2081cbfead400f'

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def cpu(usage):
    return {'user_seconds': usage.ru_utime, 'system_seconds': usage.ru_stime}

def total(value):
    return sum(value.values())

def spawn(code):
    return subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', code], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

def reap(child):
    pid, status, usage = os.wait4(child.pid, 0)
    child.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
    child.stdin.close()
    assert pid == child.pid and child.returncode == 0
    return {'pid': pid, 'returncode': child.returncode, 'cpu': cpu(usage)}

busy = 'import time\nend=time.process_time()+0.5\nwhile time.process_time()<end: pass\n'
idle = 'import time; time.sleep(0.65)'
read = 'import sys; assert sys.stdin.buffer.read(1)==b"x"'
cases = []
for name, code in [('cpu_bound', busy), ('sleeping_process', idle), ('blocked_pipe', read)]:
    before = cpu(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN))
    started = time.time()
    child = spawn(code)
    if name == 'blocked_pipe':
        time.sleep(0.65)
        child.stdin.write(b'x')
        child.stdin.flush()
    specific = reap(child)
    wall = time.time() - started
    after = cpu(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN))
    delta = {k: after[k] - before[k] for k in before}
    cases.append({'case': name, 'child_source': code, 'wall_seconds': wall,
                  'child': specific, 'aggregate_children_delta': delta})
    assert abs(total(delta) - total(specific['cpu'])) < 0.005

before = cpu(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN))
started = time.time()
reviewer = spawn('import time; time.sleep(0.9)')
unrelated = spawn(busy)
unrelated_usage = reap(unrelated)
reviewer_usage = reap(reviewer)
wall = time.time() - started
after = cpu(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN))
delta = {k: after[k] - before[k] for k in before}
confound = {'reviewer_source': 'import time; time.sleep(0.9)',
            'unrelated_source': busy, 'wall_seconds': wall,
            'reviewer': reviewer_usage, 'unrelated': unrelated_usage,
            'aggregate_children_delta': delta}
assert total(delta) - total(reviewer_usage['cpu']) > 0.4
assert abs(total(delta) - total(reviewer_usage['cpu']) -
           total(unrelated_usage['cpu'])) < 0.005
assert total(cases[0]['child']['cpu']) > 0.45
assert all(c['wall_seconds'] > 0.6 and total(c['child']['cpu']) < 0.3
           for c in cases[1:])

report = json.loads((JOB / 'report.json').read_text())
target = json.loads((JOB / 'target.json').read_text())
verification = json.loads((JOB / 'verification.json').read_text())
artifacts = [{'id': a, 'after_bytes': (JOB / 'artifacts' / a / 'after').stat().st_size}
             for a in target['artifacts']]
job_evidence = {
    'job_id': JOB.name,
    'record_sha256': {name: sha((JOB / name).read_bytes()) for name in
                      ['report.json', 'target.json', 'verification.json']},
    'verdict': report['verdict'], 'finding_count': len(report['findings']),
    'run_metadata': {k: report['run_metadata'][k] for k in
                     ['model', 'effort', 'elapsed_seconds', 'target_bytes']},
    'artifacts': artifacts,
    'verification_result': verification['verification_result'],
    'application_result': verification['application_result'],
}
assert report['run_metadata']['elapsed_seconds'] == 10657.211
assert sum(a['after_bytes'] for a in artifacts) == 25628 and len(artifacts) == 2

p = subprocess.run(['pmset', '-g', 'log'], capture_output=True, text=True)
dated = [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('2026-')]
power = {'argv': ['pmset', '-g', 'log'], 'returncode': p.returncode,
         'stderr': p.stderr, 'first_record_prefix': dated[0][:25] if dated else None,
         'last_record_prefix': dated[-1][:25] if dated else None,
         'matching_sleep_wake_lines': [line for line in dated if
             line.startswith(('2026-09-18', '2026-09-19')) and
             any(word in line for word in ['Sleep', 'Wake'])]}
p = subprocess.run(['man', 'caffeinate'], env=dict(os.environ, MANPAGER='cat'),
                   capture_output=True)
clean = subprocess.run(['col', '-b'], input=p.stdout, capture_output=True).stdout
manual = {'argv': ['man', 'caffeinate'], 'returncode': p.returncode,
          'formatted_stdout_sha256': sha(clean),
          'idle_sleep_option_present': b'prevent the system from idle sleeping' in clean,
          'system_sleep_option_ac_restriction_present': b'running on AC power' in clean}
assert manual['idle_sleep_option_present'] and manual['system_sleep_option_ac_restriction_present']

source = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()
result = {
    'collected_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'reviewed_revision': 'e1ceb83',
    'source_sha256': {name: sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) for name in
                     ['docs/plans/phase-1b.md', 'src/codex_review/reviewer.py',
                      'src/codex_review/main.py']},
    'control_python': {'executable': sys.executable, 'version': sys.version},
    'job': job_evidence, 'controls': cases, 'concurrent_child_control': confound,
    'power_log_availability': power, 'caffeinate_manual': manual,
    'documentation': ['https://docs.python.org/3/library/resource.html#resource.getrusage',
                      'https://docs.python.org/3/library/os.html#os.wait4'],
    'collector_source': source.decode(), 'collector_sha256': sha(source),
    'limits': ['No host suspend, live reviewer or remote inference was exercised.',
               'The retained power log has no matching September 18/19 sleep/wake records.',
               'Local CPU cannot attribute a wait to system sleep, network or remote model work.',
               'No historical CPU usage, exact sleep duration or causal attribution is recovered.',
               'The suggested 164–550-second comparison and historical caffeinate wrapper were not reverified.',
               'wait4 demonstrates child attribution here; it is not a production API selection.'],
}
path = ROOT / 'docs/history/phase-1b-duration-evidence-2026-09-25.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'archive': str(path), 'job': job_evidence,
                  'controls': [{'case': c['case'], 'wall_seconds': c['wall_seconds'],
                                'local_cpu_seconds': total(c['child']['cpu'])} for c in cases],
                  'concurrent_child_cpu': {'reviewer': total(reviewer_usage['cpu']),
                      'unrelated': total(unrelated_usage['cpu']), 'aggregate': total(delta)},
                  'power_log_availability': power}, indent=2))
